admission.reason: Twelve exact CellBody objects pass DAT checksum, raw flag, empty-value CellBody presence, independent somaContour and MBF closure gates. Non-soma objects remain excluded.

hardBoundaries: Raw sourceClosedFlag=false is preserved. Only the exact named, presence-tagged, independently classified source objects receive the MBF cell-body closure interpretation.
Ordered line loops only; no filled polygon, loft, surface, membrane, volume, organelle, biological measurement, standardized SWC overlay, same-cell molecular join or atlas registration is admitted.
Other DAT tree, branch, spine-labelled and marker objects are excluded; handler counts do not establish biological spines or synapses.
Source age is 35–98 days. Native drawing-width numbers do not override the standardized SWC No Diameter declaration; axon and dendrite integrity remain incomplete/moderate.
